context: Sho-young throws beans for setsubun while Daichi plays oni demon.
purpose: Father and child enacting traditional ritual playfully.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Bright, high-pitched call of discovery. Sharp attack on the first word to grab attention. Excited but controlled — he's announcing, not screaming. Warm undercurrent of wanting Dad to play along.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.style: Big, booming Kansai drawl. Bright energy instantly matched to his son's pitch. Play-acting surprise with exaggerated openness. Leans into the fun without overshadowing the child's moment.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Quick, urgent instruction wrapped in delight. Slight breathlessness — he's moving as he speaks. The pitch rises slightly at the end, almost a question: are you ready?

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.en: Out with the demon, in with good fortune!
lines.style: Loud, rhythmic chant in warm Kansai dialect. Theatrical delivery — knows the words matter even as he plays. Steady pace, landing each phrase with presence and generosity.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Soft, almost reflective completion. The excitement settles into contentment. Warm exhale at the end — he's savoring the moment with his father, not performing it anymore.
